entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: An archdruid of Aerona on Dominaria who briefly became a planeswalker, led an army against evil wizards, lost her spark restoring Lat-Nam, and was later reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Aerona lies and which Greensleeves swears to protect.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: The part of Dominaria where Greensleeves lived and fought.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: The forest whose overwhelming magic and noise clouded Greensleeves' thoughts and kept her from speaking.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: A village on the border of the Whispering Woods, home of Greensleeves' family, destroyed during a wizards' duel.

entities.name: Destruction of White Ridge
entities.description: The destruction of the village of White Ridge during a wizard's duel, which killed many villagers including Greensleeves' parents and two siblings.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Greensleeves' brother, a woodcutter who becomes Towser's freightmaster and later leads the army against evil wizards.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Greensleeves' and Gull's long-lost brother, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser into the Keldon warlord, a war machine.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A wizard who hires Gull as freightmaster, seeks to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault, and leads the evil wizards against her.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: Gull's girlfriend, later his wife, who is revealed to be a wizard.

entities.name: Kem
entities.description: A bodyguard of Towser who changes sides to rescue Greensleeves and is later swept away by the sea.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: An old druid who trains Greensleeves with time-dilating magic, gives her a Nova Pentacle and her remaining life force, and later visits as a shade.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: A living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam to stop the Brothers' War, able to stop wizards from using magic; Towser believed it a mana vault.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A wizard and self-appointed King of the Badlands who steals the Stone Brain with Phyrexian gremlins and fights Greensleeves.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Greensleeves' lover, who brings her to her senses at Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: A long-lost island holding the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, where the Sages hid the Stone Brain's secret; Greensleeves restores it.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The battle at Lat-Nam in which Greensleeves' army fought Towser and the evil wizards.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The home plane of the Phyrexian gremlins and demons, to which Greensleeves planeswalks to recover the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The plane's greatest enemies, whose return Greensleeves senses before being reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: A planeswalker who visits the army to reunite with his family and gifts Greensleeves his spell satchel.

entities.name: Rakel
entities.description: Member of the army who drills its soldiers and is taken to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Petalia
entities.description: Captain of Greensleeves' bodyguard, lost in the Abyss when Ur-Drago was banished.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: An elemental who aids the evil wizards and is banished by Greensleeves.

entities.name: Gurias
entities.description: An evil wizard who kills one of Greensleeves' bodyguards and is killed by her.

entities.name: Guardians of the Grove
entities.description: Greensleeves' bodyguards, who carried shields painted with a white sleeve with green cuffs.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The creators of the Stone Brain, who set the Duler Angels and the merfolk of the Copper Conch to guard Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A merfolk who carries Greensleeves to the underwater portion of the College.

entities.name: Force of Nature
entities.description: A creature Greensleeves summons that drains the magic of the enemy mages.

entities.name: Queen Thunderhead
entities.description: One of the evil wizards, made to fall into a fissure by Greensleeves.

events.summary: A shooting star falls in the woods near White Ridge, reputed to be a bad omen.
events.quote: a shooting star fell in the woods northwest of their village, which was reputed to be a bad omen

events.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizards' duel, killing Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings.
events.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings

events.summary: Towser hires Gull as freightmaster and Gull brings Greensleeves along.
events.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer and brought Greensleeves along.

events.summary: Greensleeves unknowingly summons a Fungusaur that defeats a wizard who kidnapped her and Lily.
events.quote: The wizard was defeated by a Fungusaur summoned by Greensleeves, though neither knew it at the time.

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves rescue Kem from Sedge Trolls in a bog, and Greensleeves is found to be able to speak.
events.quote: Gull was amazed to find out that Greensleeves could suddenly talk

events.summary: Towser reveals his plan to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault; a fight starts and Towser teleports Gull and friends to an island.
events.quote: the wizard revealed his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault

events.summary: Lily summons Gull back; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons the creatures of the woods against Towser's minions.
events.quote: Kem changed sides and came to her rescue

events.summary: Greensleeves uses an earthquake and a tsunami to defeat Towser, who escapes by flying; Gull's group survives and they vow to form an army against evil wizards.
events.quote: They vowed to form an army to fight Towser and all other evil wizards who saw people as mindless pawns.

events.summary: Led by a strange voice, Greensleeves finds the druid Chaney, who trains her; five years pass in a few days and she returns grown and more skilled.
events.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

events.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney learn the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, and Greensleeves uses it on Haakon.
events.quote: the Mana Vault was in reality the Stone Brain

events.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian gremlins who snatch the Stone Brain and return to Phyrexia.
events.quote: they snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane

events.summary: Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia with friends, dons the Stone Brain, and uses spells from its voices to destroy demons and return home.
events.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

events.summary: Garth visits the army and gifts Greensleeves his spell satchel.
events.quote: gifting Greensleeves his spell satchel

events.summary: Chaney, dying of old age, gives Greensleeves her remaining life force, making her an archdruid.
events.quote: Chaney gave her remaining life force to Greensleeves, making her an archdruid.

events.summary: The army liberates almost all of Northern Aerona from evil wizards, but Greensleeves is worn down and Chaney's shade warns of a final sacrifice.
events.quote: liberated almost all of Northern Aerona from evil wizards

events.summary: Ten wizards led by Towser and Karli, with Ur-Drago and a Keldon warlord, attack the army from three directions; Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago, losing Petalia to the Abyss.
events.quote: Petalia , captain of her bodyguard, was lost in the Abyss when the druid banished Ur-Drago.

events.summary: Greensleeves teleports the survivors to her Grove, then kills Gurias in fury and drives off the enemy.
events.quote: Greensleeves unleashed her fury, killing him and summoning her most powerful spells, which caused the enemy to flee.

events.summary: Greensleeves learns the Stone Brain's ultimate secret lies in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, and the army teleports there; Chaney's shade passes on.
events.quote: The party teleported to Lat-Nam

events.summary: After battle, Greensleeves parleys with the Duler Angels and the merfolk guardians and they help excavate the ruins.
events.quote: Befriending them by explaining the common goal, the rest of the army was summoned to the ruins, and excavation was started.

events.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves underwater where she asks a Sage's skull for the Stone Brain's secret.
events.quote: She mentally asked the skull for the secret of the Stone Brain.

events.summary: Towser and the other wizards attack; Gull's prophetic dream reveals the Keldon warlord is his brother.
events.quote: this made him realize what the warlord's identity was

events.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, and the brothers reconcile.
events.quote: the two brothers reconciled

events.summary: Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves, mad with grief, makes her final sacrifice, destroying the wizards' magic, and becomes godlike.
events.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and briefly lost herself completely

events.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses; she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, healing the land, and loses her spark.
events.quote: This outpouring of mana caused Greensleeves to lose her spark.

events.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; the other wizards keep theirs to do good and pledge obedience, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
events.quote: who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

events.summary: Hundreds of years later, sensing the Phyrexians' return, Greensleeves is reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods.
events.quote: Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods, a being of pure elemental power

relations.quote: Greensleeves lived peacefully with her brothers Gull and Sparrow Hawk
Greensleeves lived peacefully with her brothers Gull and Sparrow Hawk
willing to teach the inexperienced Greensleeves everything she knew about magic
in the company of her lover Kwam and her brother Gull

relations.note: Towser wanted to kill her and she fought his wizards
relations.quote: the wizard revealed his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault

relations.note: the Sages created the Stone Brain
relations.quote: a living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam in hopes of stopping the Brothers' War
